name: list_overrides
note: Hand corrections. tools/canon/build_lists_from_imdb.py NEVER writes this file, so nothing here is lost when the generated lists are rebuilt.

always_recommend.why: Films that must be recommended even if the generated canon missed them, or the exclusion rule caught them. Give an imdb_id where you can — it resolves exactly. Title and year also work.

never_recommend.why: Films that must never be recommended even though they had a theatrical release. This is the only place a judgement call belongs; the generated lists are evidence-only.
